extensionDescription.message: Clears stale browser data from sites you no longer visit.
extensionDescription.description: Description of the extension shown in the add-on store and manager.

popupScanButton.description: Button in the popup that starts a scan (preview, nothing is deleted).

popupNoScanYet.description: Placeholder status shown in the popup before the first scan.

popupScanning.description: Status shown while a scan is in progress.

sectionStale.description: Heading of the list of stale sites; $COUNT$ is the number of sites.

sectionUnknown.description: Heading of the list of sites with no recorded visit; unchecked by default.

summaryFreshProtected.description: Summary line for sites that are not shown in the lists.

cookieCount.description: Number of cookies in a site group.

lastVisit.description: Last visit date of a site, shown next to the cookie count.

partitionedBadge.description: Badge on third-party cookies partitioned under another site.

partitionedUnder.description: Tooltip explaining which top-level site a partitioned cookie belongs to.

protectButton.description: Per-site button that adds the site to the whitelist.

deleteButton.description: Button that deletes the selected cookies; $COUNT$ is the cookie count.

emptyState.description: Status shown when a scan finds no cookies at all.

optionsThresholdLabel.message: Consider a site stale after this many days without a visit:
optionsThresholdLabel.description: Label of the staleness threshold input.

optionsKeepUnknownLabel.message: Never preselect cookies from sites with no recorded visit
optionsKeepUnknownLabel.description: Checkbox that stops never-visited sites from being preselected for deletion.

optionsKeepUnknownHint.message: When off, these cookies are preselected for deletion — unless the scan finds no visit data at all, in which case nothing is preselected. You can always change the selection before deleting.

optionsWhitelistHint.message: Cookies from these sites are never deleted.

optionsAdd.description: Button that adds a domain to the whitelist.

optionsRemove.description: Button that removes a domain from the whitelist.

optionsSaved.description: Brief confirmation after settings are stored.
